name: BTA Two App Ext A
brief: Peer app A: extends the platform Item table (27) with its own tableextension.
description: One of two PEER apps in the same bundle that each extend the platform Item table. Neither depends on the other; both are compiled from source in the same run. Exists so the runner's per-base-table extension merge (RecordPatches._parsedExtensionFields, keyed on the base table name with no app qualifier) can be shown to keep two apps' extension fields distinct. See BTA Two App Ext Main for the assertions.
